descriptionPlain: Example Works makes scheduling software for field teams. We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer for the product engineering group. You will build the planner and dispatch surfaces in TypeScript and React, own the performance budget for them, and pair with a designer who sits in the same squad. Our stack is React, TypeScript, Vite, and a Python API. We are fully remote across EMEA, asynchronous by default, with two overlap hours a day. We can employ in several European countries and otherwise contract with EU-registered companies.

Own the mobile web experience: a React and TypeScript progressive web app used by field crews on low-end Android devices in poor coverage. Offline-first, small bundles, real constraints. Remote within Europe.
Close new business across the DACH region. Hybrid from our Munich office, with regular travel to customer sites. Fluent German required.
